## Activity

During January 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 379 image captures. This records the volume of activity completed at the site during the month and provides the basis for the quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 18 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.7%. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the total activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 93 referable results. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 2. This indicates the typical time taken for a captured image to progress through the grading process. The figures provide a summary of activity, image usability and grading outcomes for West Gate Eye Clinic in January 2023.
